svg.title: Email in: a message to an address becomes a ticket, and replies become comments — SoftTrack web design mockup (#288)
svg.desc: SoftTrack sends email and reads none, so every request a support team handles is typed in from an inbox and every answer typed back. A team has an address; a new message becomes a ticket with the sender as its requester; a public comment is emailed to the requester; and a reply becomes a comment on the right ticket.
svg.text: Email in: a message to an address becomes a ticket, and replies become comments
A message becomes a ticket, and a reply a comment

g.text: Invoice export is missing VAT numbers
Hello, the CSV export of our invoices has no VAT numbers in it since last week. Our accountant needs them by Friday. Thanks,
Created from an email, today at 09:12
Thanks Priya. Which export did you use: the one on the invoices page, or the monthly statement?
The one on the invoices page, Download as CSV.
Quoted history and a signature were trimmed · Show the message as it arrived
Second report of this today. Asking Engineering whether the column was dropped in 1.4.
A public reply is emailed to priya@acme.example
Mail to this address becomes tickets on Support.

Done when a team has an address fed by IMAP polling or a provider’s webhook, a new message becomes a ticket in the intake status with attachments through the existing
pipeline, the sender becomes the requester, public comments are emailed and internal notes never are, a reply becomes a comment with quoted history trimmed, automatic
replies, bounces and the instance’s own mail create nothing, a team chooses who may write in, and the original message can be read from the ticket.
